data.title: Start your first *Cowork* task
data.subtitle: Same message box as a chat. Pick how much Claude checks with you.

composer.text: Turn the receipts in my Claude Work folder into an expense report. Interview me first, one question at a time.

steps: For your first task, choose **Manually approve**
Describe the result in a line or two
Answer its questions, read the plan, then let it run
data.note: No Chat or Cowork option? You have the new Claude experience: just describe the task. Drawn from the official help pages; your screen may differ.
